snippet.title: Zwamman announcement trailer
snippet.description:
Free demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4501000/Zwamman

Zwamman is a zero pressure single screen puzzle game in which you have to use your light to help Zwamman find crystals in dark forests and swamps. Use the crystals to light a path to Zwamman's home and reveal the true nature of the scary monsters.

Music by Tomomi Kato from Pixabay, remixed by Baardmoeder.
